No.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. : D.
I. O. REG
No. 598
Dat. 28. 9. 16.

September 26th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang in consequence of the reprimand he recently received from the Central Government for participating in the despatching of a telegram which was sent to Peking protesting against the retention in office of Tsang Au Tsing 張耀曾the Minister of Justice, sent a staff officer named Waung 王 to Hsuchowfu to represent him there at the Headquarters of General Chang Hsun. Waung was seen there by the men of Tuchun Feng Kou Chang who sent a staff officer to Shanghai to interview General Yang with a view to ascertaining the result of the conference with General Chang Hsun.
The supporters of Huang Hsin 黃興 and Han Hwei 韓恢 are very dissatisfied with the repatriation scheme and will hold a meeting to-day at the Zee Yuen 全安 teashop near Pah Sion Jao Frenchtown to decide on the manner of approaching Dr. Sun Yat Sen on the subject.
The painters strike is still on, the workmen being dissatisfied with the terms granted by the master painters.
Four hundred mechanics who have been engaged for munition work in France were paid an advance of a month and a half wages viz $99.00 at 50 Wan Zung Li 匯成里 Frenchtown on the 25th inst.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：DS ... 16/9）

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号：
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。

C. : D.
I. O. REG
第 598 号
日期：16. 9. 28.

1916年9月26日。

先生：

据报，杨将军因参与发送一封致北京的电报而近期受到中央政府的申斥，该电报抗议留任司法总长张耀曾（Tsang Au Tsing），为此他派遣一名姓王（Waung）的参谋前往徐州府，代表他在张勋将军总部行事。督军冯国璋（Feng Kou Chang）的部下在那里见到了王某，并派出一名参谋前往上海会见杨将军，以探明与张勋将军会谈的结果。

黄兴（Huang Hsin）和韩恢（Han Hwei）的支持者对遣返计划非常不满，将于今日在法租界八仙桥附近的全安（Zee Yuen）茶馆举行会议，决定就此事项接洽孙中山博士的方式。

油漆工罢工仍在继续，工人们对领班油漆工所给予的条件感到不满。

受雇前往法国从事军火工作的四百名技工，于本月25日在法租界汇成里（50 Wan Zung Li）预支了一个半月的工资，即99.00美元。

您的顺从仆人，

（签名）
首席侦探督察。

（批注：DS ... 16/9）

警察总监上尉。
